instruction: A candid full shot of an indoor dance studio with a wooden floor. On the right, the woman in the red dress (R1) stands with her back to the camera, showing the low-cut back of her red dress. She has her left arm wrapped around the shoulder of the man in the striped polo (R2), who stands on the left facing right. They are locked in a close dance embrace, practicing their steps. The background features plain walls and a tripod. Warm indoor lighting illuminates the dancers, casting soft shadows on the floor.
